body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Toshiba showcased its new Satellite brand laptop 'U505' at CES 2010, equipped with a full-range of processor options offered in the 2010 Intel Core processor family.

Lightweight at less than 5 pounds and exceptionally stylish, Satellite U505 Series laptops offer lightweight portability in a compact and chic package. The Satellite U505 features a 13-inch diagonal widescreen display and is wrapped in a unique Texture Finish in Luxe Brown, White or Pink.

With configurations featuring Intel Core i3-330M and Core i5-430M processors, the laptop delivers multimedia performance and entertaining features, plus innovative new mobile technologies – like an optional Touch Screen and built-in WiMax perfect to keep you productive, entertained and connected with style and starts at $649.99 MSRP2.
